headlines.text: Fed's Oct. 28 minutes show Waller open to a 50bp December hike if inflation stays hot, with most officials still seeing another rate rise likely this year after the Fed held at 3.75%-4.00% in a 10-2 vote
Dow sheds ~561 points (-1.1%) to 50,198 and Nvidia slides a fifth straight session as Wall Street braces for Anthropic's blockbuster Nasdaq debut; Nasdaq edges up 0.4%

Anthropic guides its IPO to price above $80/share tonight — topping its $70-$78 range — on roughly $400B of institutional and near $100B of retail demand, valuing the AI lab well above $1.4T ahead of Thursday's Nasdaq debut as ANT
Nvidia posts blowout Q3 revenue of $115.8B (+103% YoY) but shares fall for a fifth session as investors digest interim CEO Colette Kress's first earnings call since Jensen Huang's abrupt resignation
Target's Q3 comparable sales jump 5.6% with adjusted EPS of $2.65 (boosted ~$0.50 by a one-time tariff refund) as turnaround accelerates; retailer raises full-year sales growth outlook to ~6%
Lowe's Q3 sales rise to $22.8B with comps up 1.8% — a sixth straight quarter of positive comps — as adjusted EPS climbs to $3.10; retailer lifts full-year sales outlook to ~$92.5B
